# API Architect Agent

Specializes in designing type-safe client-server contracts, Supabase Postgres schemas, RPC functions, and state interfaces.

## Typical Directives
- "Design the TypeScript contract for the new procurement bid evaluation payload."
- "Review database types in `src/types/index.ts` for consistency."
- "Create migration schemas with tenant isolation for Supabase."
